issues: Radix DialogClose sr-only English 'Close' label still leaks (same issue reported in iter17 as cosmetic). Everything else in Exchange dialog is translated.

The in-card lang switcher (data-testid=lang-ar) only flips the wrapper dir attribute — it does NOT set document.documentElement.dir=rtl. Global lang switch (localStorage ariadni_lang=ar) correctly sets html dir=rtl. If the intent is that visitors of a public card can independently set RTL, consider mirroring i18n.dir onto <html> when the switcher is used, so global consent banner + toasts also flip to RTL. Cosmetic / design decision.

Message is localized via i18n key but /does-not-exist-xyz shows English by default because visitors have no lang preset. If the requirement is to auto-detect Accept-Language, this is not implemented (acceptable — most public visitors use browser/global lang store).

critical_code_review_comments: platform_v1.py is still >2100 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth/rate-limit, workspaces/team, billing, referrals, webhooks, account/gdpr).
delete_account (platform_v1.py L855) is correct — deletes cascade only for owned workspaces and removes just membership from shared workspaces. Good defensive design. Confirmed by test.
get_public_card / get_vcard both correctly require status='published' AND active entitlement (410 when inactive). VCF for draft returns 404 — verified.

Login lockout keyed on (ip:email) via db.login_attempts is reasonable. Behind CDN/proxy the x-forwarded-for is honored (client_ip helper handles first hop). Consider adding a per-account counter (independent of IP) to prevent distributed brute force from bypassing the per-IP window.

rate_limit() uses an in-memory _RL_BUCKETS dict — will not scale across workers. If backend runs multi-worker (uvicorn --workers>1) or multi-pod, limits are per-process. Move to Redis or a shared store for production. Not blocking for MVP.

Settings.jsx: 'Delete account' relies on user typing t('dataRights.confirmWord') (localized). If the localized confirm word is not the English 'DELETE' in AR/ES, the E2E test in this file that fills 'DELETE' still works because tests run with default EN. That is fine; document this expectation.

PublicProfile: the in-card LanguageSwitcher (lang-ar/lang-en/lang-es) updates i18n.changeLanguage locally but does not update document.documentElement.dir. If a public-card-only visitor picks Arabic, the Exchange dialog inside the same tree is translated but the page-level dir stays LTR. Consider unifying via useEffect that syncs i18n.language to <html dir>.

rca of the issue: Rebrand miss on Landing: the three ARIADNI ID strings live as literal JSX text (not i18n keys) in the Landing page component. Because they were never routed through t() nor globally search-and-replaced, the rebrand pass missed them. Reproduction: open https://template-hub-184.preview.emergentagent.com/ and search DOM text for /ARIADNI/i — 3 hits. Fix: replace the literal strings with 'TapPresence' (and where appropriate a t() key so AR/ES also localize).
